items.title: PARR's Refining Strength and Integrated Platform Support Growth

items.title: Why Everyone Is Watching Valero Energy (VLO) Right Now
items.summary: Fresh earnings news put Valero Energy (VLO) back in focus after the refiner reported revenue and EPS above consensus estimates, prompting many investors to reassess what the recent share move really reflects. Recent trading tells a mixed story. Valero Energy’s share price has pulled back sharply, with a 1 day decline of 1.52% and a 30 day slide of 21.91%. items.title: Trump Cheers the “Biggest Drop in Gasoline in 18 Years.” Not Good for Exxon and Chevron
items.summary: Key TakeawaysPresident Trump cheered gasoline’s biggest drop in 18 years, and Brent crude is down 22% in November. ExxonMobil and Chevron rode the Iran war’s spike in crude to a huge 2026, and that windfall is now reversing.

items.title: Valero's Crude Flexibility & Gulf Coast Network Boost Prospects
items.summary: VLO benefits from strong refining margins, resilient fuel demand and crude-processing flexibility, though rising crude and freight costs pose risks.

items.title: Your Chevron Hedge Works Only While Oil Spikes
items.summary: Our Nov 18 look at Chevron found the stock moving on its own. Chevron gained 2.3% from November 10 to November 17, while the S&P 500 lost 2.4%. For the full record, see Is Chevron Stock Increasing Your Market Risk? The next question is whether Chevron protects a portfolio when oil prices jump.
